# Idempotent repository registration

Registering an existing repository slug updates its forge_ref, default_branch, and config_ref in-place and returns its id; no duplicate slugs can exist.

Avoids duplicate repository entries and allows updates to repository metadata through repeated registration attempts.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.register_repository`
